scripts.setup: docker compose up -d --wait && npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:reset: npm run docker:reset && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U app -d app
